The '''Well''' is a [[Carpenter's Shop#Farm Buildings|farm building]] purchasable from [[Robin]] at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] that allows the player to refill their [[Watering Cans|Watering Can]].  It takes two days for Robin to complete its construction.

==Behavior==
Interacting with the well with a watering can equipped will refill it as if the player was next to water.
